status: actual registered source schemas; handlers not executed for schema capture

tools.name: skillbuilder_resources
tools.description: Report this machine's CPU, RAM, free disk, GPU (NVIDIA via nvidia-smi), common executables with versions, cached model names, and the host's registered tools and skills. Names only: loads no model, reads no credentials.

tools.name: skillbuilder_save
tools.description: Save a draft SKILL.md as a new numbered revision under the plugin data folder. Never overwrites an earlier revision and installs nothing.

tools.name: skillbuilder_check
tools.description: Check a saved draft revision (or unsaved text) and report each check separately with offending lines: frontmatter, description quality, size, personal paths, provider ids, acceptance, degraded mode, retired workflows, harness neutrality, side effects, referenced files and tools, and recorded contrasting cases.

tools.name: skillbuilder_case
tools.description: Record your walk-through of one contrasting case for a draft revision: limited-offline, capable-gpu-cached or hosted-selected. Returns which cases are still missing.

tools.name: skillbuilder_install
tools.description: Install a checked draft revision as a skill. Refuses failing checks, missing contrasting cases and overwrites, and always requires a person to confirm.
